scope: Offline FSIM replay viewer: pitch, 22 placeholder players, ball, score, controls, half-speed playback

build.prerequisite_installed: Microsoft.Net.Component.4.8.SDK via existing Visual Studio Build Tools 2022 installer

controls.name: Putar / Jeda
controls.evidence: Click starts playback; pause freezes clip at 2.7 seconds and match time 03:33 across successive observations.

controls.name: Ulang / R
controls.evidence: Button and keyboard R reset clip to start and play; score returns to 0-0 in goal clip.

controls.name: Speed toggle
controls.evidence: Button changes 0.5x to 1.0x and back; runtime logs confirm both rates. Native automation validates time scaling.

controls.name: Seek slider
controls.evidence: Drag while paused changes clip position to 7.5 seconds and updates player positions and match time 04:02.

controls.name: Space shortcut
controls.evidence: Space resumes playback and pauses again.

controls.name: Automatic end / goal
controls.evidence: Playback reaches 15.0 seconds, changes button to Putar, score 1-0, time 04:47, GOL banner.

controls.name: Akhir laga
controls.evidence: Loads second clip at 88:30, score 26-15. Seek to end shows 90:00, SELESAI, score 27-15.

controls.name: Klip gol
controls.evidence: Reloads first clip at 03:17, score 0-0, clip start paused.

desktop_verification.final_state: Viewer open, goal clip paused around 5.6 seconds, playback rate 0.5x

limitations: Players use basic shapes; final character meshes, skeletal animation and production stadium are not included.
Current camera is distant and field markings have low contrast; visual polish remains.
Sample clips contain only the last 15 presentation seconds from the stage 2.1 replay ring buffer, not a complete 15-minute highlight.
Final sample score 27-15 reflects existing prototype simulation data; AI realism has not been tuned in this viewer task.
Live C-API DLL integration, Android packaging and a standalone Shipping build are not included.
screenshot_note: Saved during the initial successful runtime inspection before resumed control testing.
